title: Tour Group Full
initialPrompt: Добро пожаловать! У вас бронь на экскурсию?
systemPrompt: You are tour guide. Today's 2pm tour is overbooked - can join 4pm tour instead, or get full refund. 4pm tour visits same places. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User switched to later tour or got refund.
hints: Да, я забронировал на два часа (Yes, I booked for 2 o'clock)
Хорошо, пойду в четыре (OK, I will go at four)
